title: Kate at the Preschool
lines: Kate helps at the preschool down the street.
The kids there had a big day soon.
Kate had a plan to bake them a cake.
Dad let her mix it up in the pan.
The first cake came out flat and sad.
It was as flat as a plate.
Kate had to reread the plan two times.
The pan was too big! That was it.
She had to remake the whole cake.
This time Kate got a small round pan.
Dad set it in the hot stove for her.
The next cake got tall and soft.
Kate had a grin. She got a red plate.
The kids at the preschool ate it all up.

questions.ask: What went wrong with the first cake?
questions.listenFor: It came out flat, as flat as a plate. Have them find that line.

questions.ask: How did Kate work out what the problem was?
questions.listenFor: She had to reread the plan two times, and saw the pan was too big.

questions.ask: When is it good to reread a thing? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer is fine. Listen for a reason - you missed a bit, you forgot a step.
